name: paxos-cert-control
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; mkdir -p base; tar -xf replay-input/main.tar -C base; for mode in facts singletons both legacy-cert; do TRACK_GEN_DISPOSABLE=1 bun research/track-gen/cert-control.ts "$mode"; echo MODE=$mode; set +e; GDP_COUNTS_TRACE=1 taskset -c 0-3 timeout -s KILL 60 bun research/protocols/ic3syn/run.ts --only paxos_epr --skip broken --ms 60000; echo EXIT=$?; set -e; done
